newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks extend gains in active week.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks extend gains in active week.

text.p: Oman stocks posted strong gains in the week to Wednesday with the index climbing by 2.4 percent to reach 214.39 points from last week's 209.36.
Turnover was strong, with the daily value of trade ranging between 2.24 million and 3.38 million rials ($5.94-8.96 million).
A big mover in the week was National Bank of Oman, which ended up at 4.530 rials from the previous week's 3.900 rials on expectations of good 1996 results.
"NBO saw wild movements in price, starting the day at 4.500 rising to 4.650 and then falling back to close at 4.530," said Gulf Investment Services in its Wednesday market report.
Another big winner in the week was Al-Ahlia Portfolio Securities, which ended at 4.260 rials from 3.820.
Oman International Bank's gains were not as dramatic, but it recovered the previous week's lost ground to end 0.150 rials higher at 4.150.
Wednesday trading saw Oman Securities Portfolio close six percent higher at 1.210 rials on volume of 84,500 shares.
The stock exchange's climb in the week galvanised strong January gains of over 7.5 percent.

Bank and investment stocks have been the flavour of the month, with select scripts such as OIB clocking up more than 3O percent, NBO and Gulf Investment Services rising some 26 percent and Al Ahlia Portfolio gaining around 22 percent.
